title: More edible food
description: With this data pack, you can eat more items in Minecraft!
body:
With this data pack, you can eat more items in Minecraft! The eating time for different foods now varies slightly. Also, some previously inedible items are now edible. For example, you can eat grass, small flowers, and even a block of honey!

List of new edible items:
